name: lottie_author
description: Create or patch a vector animation in the job directory and save JSON plus a portable animation package.

scene.description: Strict scene object. Defaults width/height=256, fps=60, frames=90, transparent background. layers up to 64; each requires semantic name and shape rectangle, ellipse or path. Optional position/size pairs, #RRGGBB fill/stroke, stroke_width, opacity/rotation. Bezier path requires v/i/o equal arrays of xy pairs and boolean c. animate tracks use property position/scale/rotation/opacity/trim_end and strictly increasing keyframes {frame,value,easing}; easing linear/ease-in/ease-out/ease-in-out. Runtime rejects unknown fields. Canvas 16..2048, fps1..120, frames1..3600, duration<=120s.
